name: Reseller Inventory & Profit Tracker 2026 — eBay, Poshmark, Mercari, Depop, Whatnot (Excel / Google Sheets)
summary: Profit after fees on every flip: eBay, Poshmark, Mercari, Depop and Whatnot rates built in, plus ROI, death-pile alerts and tax totals.
description_html:
See your profit after eBay, Poshmark, Mercari, Depop and Whatnot fees on every sale. Inventory, ROI, days-to-sell and a Schedule-C tax summary in one spreadsheet.

A complete inventory and profit system for thrift flippers and marketplace resellers — no subscription, no app, just a spreadsheet that does the maths.

What's inside

  • Inventory — auto-generated SKUs, source, brand, cost, extra costs, status (Sourced / Listed / Sold / Returned / Donated), list price, days in inventory, and an automatic STALE flag.
  • Sales — type the SKU and the item's cost and description are pulled in. Platform fees are calculated from an editable fee table (eBay, Poshmark incl. the under-$15 flat fee, Mercari, Depop, Whatnot, Facebook Marketplace, Etsy, Other). Net profit, ROI % and days-to-sell per sale.
  • Expenses — supplies, shipping supplies, storage, subscriptions and mileage (deduction calculated at your rate).
  • Dashboard — 10 KPI tiles (inventory value at cost, sell-through rate, average profit, average ROI, average days to sell, best platform, death-pile count and cash tied up, items sold, year net profit), a Jan–Dec monthly table, and performance by platform, category and sourcing channel.
  • Death Pile — every listed item older than your stale threshold (default 60 days) with a suggested markdown price.
  • Tax Summary — gross sales, COGS, fees, shipping, expenses and mileage mapped to Schedule-C-style lines (estimate only).

Details

  • 500 items / 500 sales / 500 expense lines per copy; dropdowns; conditional formatting for stale items and negative profit.
  • Fee rates are editable approximations — update them when platforms change.
  • Excel 2016+ and Google Sheets compatible. No macros.
  • Instant download.

Want to see the fee maths before you buy? The free profit-after-fees calculator uses the same rate table as this tracker and prices one item across all five marketplaces side by side. It costs nothing and needs no email. If you like how it calculates, this is the same thing across a whole business. There is also a plain-English breakdown of what each marketplace actually takes in 2026.

Not tax advice. Verify fee rates and the mileage rate for your situation.
